caption: The drawing shows a pale beige background with various floral and leafy elements lightly sketched and colored across its surface. The foliage consists primarily of thin, curving stems with elongated blue-green leaves attached at intervals. Scattered among the leaves are small, simple flowers that have red or orange-pink petals, depicted in a loose, gestural style. The flowers are placed both singly and in small clusters. Some stems and blossoms are positioned along the edges and corners of the composition, curving inward, while others are more centrally located. The forms are outlined in soft, faint lines, and the application of color is subtle, with areas of uneven shading and transparency, contributing to an overall delicate appearance. The drawing lacks structured or solid objects; it consists entirely of stylized botanical elements distributed unevenly across the surface.
title: Free Hand Wall Decoration
